name: satwik-spot
description: Satwik Sweets and Pickels - Authentic Indian Homemade Sweets & Pickles

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:frontend
scripts.type-check: npm --prefix backend run build && tsc --noEmit --project functions/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:emulator
scripts.test:emulator: npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "npx jest --config functions/jest.config.js --runInBand"
scripts.test:rules: npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "npx jest --config functions/jest.config.js functions/tests/firestoreRules.spec.ts"
scripts.test:security: npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "npx jest --config functions/jest.config.js functions/tests/phase4Security.spec.ts"
scripts.test:sync: npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "npx jest --config functions/jest.config.js functions/tests/phase5Sync.spec.ts"
scripts.test:admin: npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "npx jest --config functions/jest.config.js functions/tests/phase6AdminDashboard.spec.ts"
scripts.test:visual: npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "npx jest --config functions/jest.config.js functions/tests/phase7VisualA11y.spec.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "npx jest --config functions/jest.config.js functions/tests/e2eBrowser.spec.ts"
scripts.verify: npm run type-check && npm run test:backend && npm run test:emulator && npm run preflight
